methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.

original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

actual_scope: Independently check #4249's depth-three minima and construction, #4263's depth-four words and #4280's row-model records with separate code, so the depth-four table for 2 <= m <= 64 no longer rests on three mutually unrechecked PRs.
scope_change_reason: #4280 states its table combines #4249 and #4263, which it does not recheck; an independent check of all three is the missing coverage.
bottleneck_link: Connector premiums decide which alphabet changes are worth pricing; the depth-three and depth-four tables are the base cases successors build on.
stop_rule: Stop once every stated minimum, word and record is reproduced or contradicted.
evidence: verify.py: depth-3 BFS m=2..8 gives 3m except 4m at (2,1),(3,2),(4,3); #4249's Lemma 3 word correct for all 79,794 pairs with 5<=m<=400 plus the (6,5) word; depth-4 BFS 12,18,20 at m=2..4; #4263's 486 words and #4280's 1,520 records (decoded from Lemma 2) all balanced and correct, covering every (m,c) with 6<=m<=64; literal noncommuting replays; rho and dropped-call controls fail.
